required_gates.what_is_checked: candidate has an explicit local checkpoint path and the path exists
required_gates.fail_condition: path missing, empty, or not configured
required_gates.blocked_unverified_condition: candidate is a slot awaiting user-provided model artifacts

required_gates.what_is_checked: license and deployment terms have been reviewed for intended use
required_gates.pass_condition: review status is explicitly allowed by repo policy for bakeoff execution
required_gates.fail_condition: review marks candidate excluded or restricted beyond bakeoff use
required_gates.evidence_required: review note or source metadata reference

required_gates.what_is_checked: local Transformers runtime can load tokenizer and model
required_gates.fail_condition: load fails with model_load_failed or backend_unavailable
required_gates.blocked_unverified_condition: runtime missing or local path not available

required_gates.what_is_checked: loaded model can execute a bounded generation call
required_gates.evidence_required: generation status and failure class if failed
contract version, parse status, schema status, retry count

required_gates.what_is_checked: candidate edits use safe workspace-relative paths and non-empty edits
required_gates.fail_condition: unsafe path, empty edit, or schema violation
required_gates.evidence_required: schema validation status and unsafe path flag

required_gates.what_is_checked: schema-valid candidate can enter a tiny controlled verifier path
required_gates.pass_condition: verifier_status=passed on a toy readiness task
required_gates.fail_condition: verifier_status=failed after a valid candidate is applied and checked
required_gates.evidence_required: tiny solve summary and verifier result

required_gates.what_is_checked: readiness smoke does not create inflated SFT-positive claims
required_gates.pass_condition: trajectory-quality audit reports no unsupported eligibility inflation
required_gates.fail_condition: backendless, fixture, or malformed traces become SFT-positive

required_gates.what_is_checked: candidate is ready to enter private hidden eval execution later
required_gates.pass_condition: all mandatory readiness gates pass and hidden eval artifacts are available
required_gates.blocked_unverified_condition: candidate lacks local model, license review, or runtime evidence
required_gates.evidence_required: readiness report and hidden eval artifact validation
